title: Registration Frontend UI & Validation Bugs
description: RegisterView.vue contains CSS display:none on error messages, mismatched button class names, and ignores owner phone collection on backend.

title: Missing Multi-Step Staged Business Onboarding Flow
description: Registration currently jumps straight to dashboard ('/') skipping essential business type, contact address, tax numbers, and receipt preferences setup.

title: Incomplete Business Profile Schema & Management Interface
description: Business entity lacks structured fields for legal name, trading name, address, city, tax numbers (NTN/STRN), phone, email, and receipt overrides.

title: Branch Creation Lacks Extended Operational Profile & Manager Assignment
description: Branches table only contains basic name/code; lacks address, city, phone, email, manager_id, and automatic inventory initialization.

title: Employee Invitation & Password Setup Lifecycle Gaps
description: Current staff creation requires plaintext admin password entry rather than a secure invitation token or first-login forced password reset flow.

title: HR / Employees View Disconnected from Backend Governance API
description: Frontend EmployeesView.vue calls non-existent /employees endpoint instead of /users API, causing broken staff listing.

title: Missing Explicit Accountant & Inventory Manager Spatie Roles
description: Only Business Owner, Branch Manager, and Salesperson are seeded; Accountant and Inventory Manager roles need canonical Spatie definition.

title: Frontend Navigation & Route Guards Lack Dynamic Role & Branch Scoping
description: All authenticated users see identical navigation sidebar and routes; Salesperson lands on Dashboard rather than /POS.

title: Super Owner Dashboard Lacks Consolidated Multi-Branch Comparison
description: Dashboard only aggregates across single active branch filter; lacks comparative multi-store revenue, ranking, and consolidated profit views.

title: Missing Super Owner Read-Only 'View As' Preview Mode
description: Owner cannot inspect HBOS from perspective of a Branch Manager or Cashier without altering real credentials; needs read-only preview guard.

title: Missing Owner Review Notes & Action Request Infrastructure
description: Owners have no lightweight mechanism to assign investigation tasks or notes to branch managers when reviewing discrepancies in preview mode.

title: Transaction Attribution Historical Snapshot Protection
description: Transactions must snapshot employee name and role at action time in audit log so future promotions/role changes do not alter historical reports.

title: Dedicated Security Events Categorization in Audit Trail
description: Audit service should explicitly categorize logins, logouts, session revocations, password resets, and preview sessions separate from business ops.

title: Strict Separation of Platform Super Admin from Business Super Owner
description: Platform-level operations (SkyraSoft) must never be conflated with customer business ownership, preventing cross-tenant security risks.
